youtube_excluded_detail: 49 visible clips are YouTube-sourced (SK678387): 11 airplane (numbers 38-48) and 38 helicopter (numbers 19-56); bird and drone visible have 0 YouTube. Clip IDs are in download_drone_visible.py's exclusion output when run with the description sheet.
bird_alignment_note: 11 bird clips were excluded for alignment: their .mat files have different depth-5 cell sizes that mcos-decoder cannot decode reliably (e.g. V_BIRD_005 decodes to 1 label, 0 present, vs 302 frames). They were excluded, not approximated.
nightskyucp_license_note: Figshare page/API says CC BY 4.0, but cr_dataset/license.txt inside the zip is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Conservative treatment: noncommercial only, ShareAlike for adapted material. Do NOT ship a model trained on NightSkyUCP in a public/commercial Magi model without author clarification. NightSkyUCP is therefore excluded from the planned distributed-model training pipeline until terms are clarified.
magi_note: Magi benchmark annotations are NOT in this PR. Real Magi footage and event exports stay out of the public repository. The Magi test split is reserved empty and is never filled with external data.
